tools.name: document_create_draft
tools.description: Create a new document draft for the user to review. Ensure the document content is comprehensive, highly structured, and detailed (typically 500-1000 words, never a short summary or placeholder). Returns a draft ID.

title.description: The title of the new document draft

content.description: Comprehensive text content, 500-1000 words, detailed sections, no placeholders

format.description: Format of the document: pdf, docx, pptx, csv, markdown, html, plaintext

summary_of_changes.description: Brief description of why this document draft was created

tools.name: document_edit_draft
tools.description: Edit an existing document and create a draft of the edits for the user to review. Ensure the updated content remains comprehensive and detailed (typically 500-1000 words). Returns a draft ID.

original_document_id.description: The ID of the document being edited

content.description: Comprehensive updated text, 500-1000 words, detailed sections

format.description: Format of the document: pdf, docx, pptx, csv, markdown, html, plaintext

summary_of_changes.description: A description of the changes made to the document

tools.name: document_export
tools.description: Export an existing document or content to a specific file format (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, CSV). The content will be LLM-optimized for the target format to ensure maximum quality and professionalism.

title.description: The title of the document to export

content.description: The content to export (if not exporting an existing document)

document_id.description: ID of an existing brain_document to export

format.description: Target export format: pdf, docx, pptx, csv, md, html

enhance.description: Whether to LLM-enhance the content for the target format (default: true)

tools.name: document_enhance
tools.description: Preview how content would be enhanced and optimized for a specific export format. Returns the enhanced content and a brief with metadata without actually generating a file.

format.description: Target format for the enhancement preview: pdf, docx, pptx, csv, md, html
